name: Transcription factors (human)
description: The 1,556 human transcription factors of the Codebook update (Jolma et al. 2026, Nature, Supplementary Table 14) to the Lambert 2018 census: the 1,639 Lambert TFs minus the 83 Codebook re-assessed as unlikely to be sequence-specific; 4 more with no Ensembl gene or symbol are left out. Lambert-era symbols are updated through their Ensembl IDs (ARNTL is BMAL1, T is TBXT). All TFs is the census; the folders split it by DNA-binding domain (a gene with two domains is in both) and by motif evidence (known motif 1,317; inferred 104; likely TF with no motif 135).
